About Post Oak Ice House

Post Oak Ice House, located at 5610 Richmond Ave., Houston, TX 77057, offers a vibrant atmosphere ideal for both casual hangouts and corporate gatherings. This venue stands out for its excellent customer service, with attentive staff who ensure a seamless experience from start to finish. The team is proactive, even customizing the environment to fit clients’ needs, such as displaying company logos during events, creating a personalized touch that enhances the overall vibe.

The ambiance at Post Oak Ice House is lively and inviting, featuring good music, games, and access to quality food trucks. It creates a dynamic space where guests can relax, socialize, and enjoy a variety of entertainment options. Whether stopping by for a quick drink or staying for several hours, visitors find themselves drawn to the friendly and efficient service. The bartenders, known for their attentiveness and warmth, manage busy periods without compromising on customer care, making sure no one waits too long for their order.

Management at Post Oak Ice House also plays a key role in maintaining a smooth operation, stepping in during peak hours to support the staff and keep the energy positive and well-organized. This commitment to both service and atmosphere reflects a team dedicated to creating memorable experiences.

Overall, Post Oak Ice House combines a strategic location with a fun, casual environment supported by a professional and personable staff. Its unique blend of great service, engaging entertainment, and a welcoming setting makes it a favored destination for those seeking a balanced mix of relaxation and social interaction in Houston.

Reviews

“ Open mic every Monday. This place is very big and awesome for parties! At the open mic I was so amazed to listen to local Houston artists singing and performing. The music started until 11:00 pm on a Monday. The food truck had delicious jalapeno and cheese and meat rolls. The drinks are great and the service is first class. They also have security. ”

Azucena Kennedy (Zuzu Kennedy)

“ My wife and I stopped by for a early evening drink and ended staying for several hours Let me tell you Cassie is not just an amazing asset to your business but and absolute joy as a person. You should be proud of finding great people to work for you and also lexi is a great manager she stepped in when it got busy and no one waited for a drink. Great place we will be back. ”

Matthew Barr

“ A Hidden Gem in Houston! I recently visited Post Oak Ice House, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is vibrant yet welcoming, making it the perfect spot to unwind after a long day or celebrate a special occasion. The cocktails are a standout—creative, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious. The new seasonal menu is a must-try; every drink is crafted with care and attention to detail. What truly sets this bar apart is the staff. They’re attentive, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. They make every guest feel like a VIP. Special shoutout to their themed nights and events—whether it’s karaoke, lotteria, or football Sundays, there’s always something fun happening. The patio is another highlight, especially in good weather. It's cozy, well-decorated, and a great place to relax with friends. Overall, Post Oak Ice House has everything you could ask for: amazing drinks, friendly service, a lively yet laid-back vibe, and events that keep you coming back for more. Highly recommend ”

Jeremy Young

“ Perfect location for a casual, corporate event. Their servers are awesome and on top of it. They even took the initiative to put our company logo on one of the tv screens. We will be back! ”

Ryan

“ Post oak Ice House has a very well maintained open bar with a lot of sitting games and friendly south. They do not serve food, but they do have a gentleman who cooks fresh food just outside. Also a great place to take your date or group. ”

Kostas Stefas

“ Great spot! Great vibe....good music...games and good food truck. I ran into a bartender named Kas the last two times I’ve been here and she is incredible! Great service and very friendly! Takes great care of all her customers. It was pretty busy but she kept up and handled the pressure. I’ll definitely be back. ”

John Colaw

“ I normally visit for casual Wednesday's for all the fighting games. The Bar staff are very friendly and really quick, but they definitely do stay busy. Their drink selection is pretty good and they also have seasonal options. Whileaybe not inside the business, they do have different food truck options available if you're hungry. ”

Manny M

“ I love the vibes here! Great music and good food options. The staff is super welcoming and friendly shoutout to the bartenders Kass, Lexi, and Mara that always make sure I have a good time! ”

Cameron McGregor

Post Oak Ice House

Post Oak Ice House, located at 5610 Richmond Ave., Houston, TX 77057, is the perfect spot for a casual hangout. With outdoor seating, great beer and cocktail selections, bar games, and fast service, it's a trendy and cosy place for groups. Enjoy a range of draft beers like St. Arnold's Art Car IPA or try seasonal specials like Spiked Matcha Hot Coco. Customers rave about the attentive servers and friendly atmosphere. Make a reservation or simply drop by for a fun time with friends. Dogs are allowed, and outside food is welcome. Don't miss out on this gem!
